_README.purpose: All Thief traits are mapped. Static effects are implemented, conditional averages are assumption-ready, and event-only traits expose exact official event packets for the future rotation engine.
_README.effect_model: Each trait now stores separate effect records so passive and event-driven portions can have different implementation states.
